dictionary.lore: This axe has seen the deaths of several owners, each of whom took a great liking to its power and used it with great care. Through these countless deaths, the lifeless Death Axe came to be known as an omen of darkness. Its dark powers enhance its user, though there is always the chance it will outlive him.
